source: MOD14A1.061 Terra only, via Planetary Computer; daily bands, not MOD14A2 composites
revision_reason: Revision 2 selected continuous 2022-2023 coverage before label inspection. Sparse stride-6 sampling yielded only two validation positives and was archived without fitting models. Revision 3 uniformly increases spatial sampling density over the same footprints, with unchanged dates, held-out tile and evaluation criteria. No model scores were available or used to make this revision.
sampling: Fixed systematic raster pixels around eight documented Argentine catalog locations; no selection by fire labels
country_filter: IGN province polygons distributed by Georef, eroded by one native pixel; exclude cells at the international border
target: Nominal/high-confidence satellite detection in the same land pixel during the next UTC calendar day, conditional on a valid target observation
available_at: Maximum of STAC timestamps, source production time and both COG Last-Modified timestamps; conservative proxy, not a first-publication log
duplicate_revision_policy: Use last produced original granule per tile and block; record earlier revisions, never merge conflicting labels. Availability belongs to that final revision.
overlapping_daily_bands: Identical pixel/day mask and QA from overlapping packages counted once at earliest availability; any conflicting mask or QA excludes that pixel/day entirely, including valid/invalid disagreements.
geographic_holdout_rule: Entire MODIS tile excluded from all training and model selection, including both Patagonian catalog regions
selection: Maximum validation average precision (PR-AUC summary), ties prefer baseline; classification threshold fixed at 0.5
experimental_visualization_gate: Selected learned model must beat all three baselines in average precision in both tests; geographic test needs at least five positive observations; Brier must not exceed the prevalence baseline in either test. This gate never grants operational approval.
